name: Leadership In The Home
overview: Scripture teaches that leadership in the home is modeled on Christ's relationship with the church, where the husband is called to be the loving head, sacrificially caring for his wife as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:23, 25). Fathers are instructed to nurture and discipline their children with the Lord’s guidance, avoiding provoking them to anger (Ephesians 6:4). Believers are encouraged to follow God’s example in all relationships (Ephesians 5:1), seeking wisdom from Him to lead their families with love and patience, as husbands are also warned against bitterness toward their wives (Colossians 3:19) and urged to ask God for wisdom when needed (James 1:5).
